name: Stop Trying To Make Fetch Happen
aka: Stop Trying To Make X Happen
look: A still from Mean Girls. Regina George (Rachel McAdams), with long blonde hair, gold hoop earrings, a pink collared shirt and a black cardigan, sits in a crowded school cafeteria and talks to someone off camera with a flat, unimpressed look.
use: The caption tells someone to give up on a nickname, trend, idea or habit that nobody else wants, in the form "Stop trying to make X happen", followed by the flat verdict "It's not going to happen."
slots: top: stop trying to make this happen
bottom: it's not going to happen
examples: Stop trying to make 8 a.m. meetings happen
Dad, stop trying to make "cowabunga" happen
describe: blonde girl in the school cafeteria telling her friend to give up
regina george at the lunch table looking annoyed
popular high school girl with hoop earrings shutting down an idea
mean girls scene about a slang word that will never catch on
rachel mcadams unimpressed in a pink shirt and black cardigan
origin: From the 2004 film Mean Girls, where Regina George tells Gretchen to stop trying to make "fetch" happen.
